title: Deep dive: Compose Multiplatform for an iOS app
description: The user is deciding whether to build an iOS app's UI with Compose Multiplatform instead of SwiftUI, and works through stability, size, performance, adoption and the earlier iOS speed-ups, with a 3-sentence limit and the term 'CMP'. Mostly the 1.8.0 and 1.7.0 release posts.

facts: Compose Multiplatform 1.8.0 brings Compose for iOS to Stable

facts: Compose Multiplatform adds only about 9 MB to an iOS app compared with a fully native SwiftUI app with the same UI logic and assets
